summary: F10 Worker × Competency Matrix: both backend endpoints and the /admin/reports/competency-matrix UI are working correctly after a single fix. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass (auth 401/403 negatives, JSON shape, status-bucket semantics, compliance excludes not_required, CSV BOM + filename + Resumen section). Frontend: admin login OK, sidebar 'Matriz por Trabajador' visible, page loads with KPIs (Trabajadores 8, Competencias 7, Vigentes 16, Por vencer 0, Vencidas 4, Faltantes 4, Cumplimiento global 67%) matching backend summary. Table renders 8 rows × 56 cells with sticky first/last columns, search/area/role/activity filters reduce rows correctly, CSV export downloads a 2017-byte file with UTF-8 BOM and the expected header 'Reporte: Matriz Trabajadores x Competencias'. Legend shows all 5 status labels. Multi-tenant scoping confirmed (only Río Loa workers returned).
action_items: (Resolved by testing agent) Added missing top-level import `StreamingResponse` in /app/backend/routes_v2.py — without it, GET /api/reports/worker-competency-matrix/export raised NameError (500). Confirm the change is acceptable; alternatively replicate the per-function local import pattern used by the compliance heatmap export.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_v2.py: `_compute_worker_matrix` correctly indexes activities by activity_id and unions competency_ids per worker; status precedence (expired → warning → valid) is correct.
Per-worker compliance uses (valid+warning)/(valid+warning+expired+missing) — matches spec (excludes not_required). Average_compliance at /summary uses the same formula across all required cells.
CSV export was missing `StreamingResponse` import — fixed. Compliance heatmap export uses a local import which is a smell; consolidate to a single top-level import for both.

Frontend CompetencyMatrix.js downloads CSV with hardcoded filename 'matriz_competencias.csv', losing the backend-provided timestamped filename ('aptiva_matriz_competencias_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.csv'). Backend filename pattern still verified directly. Consider parsing Content-Disposition for user-friendlier filename, but not a functional defect.

Frontend: 'Solo con problemas' checkbox treats `warning` as a problem; in current seed all 8 workers have at least one expired/missing/warning so the row count does not change (8→8). Verified logic; not a bug.
Worker login negative test required using a real seeded worker (jsoto@rioloaspa.cl/17234) — trabajador@aptivademo.com does not exist in current seed. Updated tests accordingly.

Si el seed cambia, el test test_compliance_excludes_not_required y test_summary_buckets_sum se autoadaptan (derivan expected del payload). El fix de StreamingResponse afecta también al endpoint /reports/compliance-heatmap/export (que ya importaba localmente), no regresiona.
rca of the issue: GET /api/reports/worker-competency-matrix/export devolvía 500 NameError: 'StreamingResponse' is not defined porque la función nueva (línea 1267 de routes_v2.py) no importaba StreamingResponse, mientras que la función pre-existente de compliance heatmap export (línea 990) la importaba de forma local dentro del cuerpo. Mitigación aplicada: agregado `StreamingResponse` al import top-level `from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, StreamingResponse`. Reproducción previa: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' $URL/api/reports/worker-competency-matrix/export` → 500. Tras el fix: 200 con CSV de 2017 bytes, BOM UTF-8 y filename `aptiva_matriz_competencias_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.csv`.
